mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of the current economic cycle.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 238.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 238.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer and business confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both increase > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both increase > 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a monthly decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5 and UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 103.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of the current economic cycle.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.2% and UNRATE decreases > 0.1% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases > 0.2% and UNRATE decreases > 0.1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with low inflation signals a dovish monetary policy shift, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.5 and FEDFUNDS declines.
